model_annotation:
This plot illustrates issued building permits for new buildings from 2012 to 2022, based on data from the National Statistical Institute (НСИ), with three categories of buildings represented. The x-axis displays years from 2012 г. to 2022 г. at regular one-year intervals on a linear scale. The y-axis represents the number of issued permits on a linear scale, ranging approximately from 70 to 8,169, though no explicit y-axis label or gridlines are shown; instead, data values are annotated directly on the plot.

Three lines are depicted. The gray line, labeled "Жилищни" (Residential), begins at 4,238 in 2012, dips slightly to 4,120 in 2013, then gradually rises through 4,245 in 2014, 4,310 in 2015, and 4,514 in 2016, before increasing more steeply to 5,460 in 2017. It then decreases to 4,826 in 2018, drops further to 4,608 in 2019, and reaches a low of 3,944 in 2020, after which it rises sharply to 4,685 in 2021 and continues upward to 4,631 in 2022. The orange line, labeled "Други" (Other), starts at 4,938 in 2012, decreases to 4,674 in 2013 and 4,323 in 2014, rises slightly to 4,382 in 2015 and peaks at 4,685 in 2016, then increases further to 5,562 in 2017. It dips to 5,774 in 2018, rises to 5,980 in 2019, decreases to 5,860 in 2020, then climbs steeply to 7,047 in 2021 and 8,169 in 2022. The light blue line, labeled "Административни" (Administrative), starts at 170 in 2012, decreases to 156 in 2013, rises to 187 in 2014, then declines through 157 in 2015 and 163 in 2016, continuing downward to 127 in 2017 and 128 in 2018, dropping to 103 in 2019 and 95 in 2020, before rising slightly to 96 in 2021 and declining to 70 in 2022, representing the lowest values across the entire plot.
